basic_details.job_title: Chief Medical Officer of Health, Purba Medinipur Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 12 Multi Purpose Worker and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Multi Purpose Worker (MPW), Yoga Instructor - Male, Yoga Instructor - Female
basic_details.short_information: Office of the Chief Medical Officer of Health, Purba Medinipur, Department of Health and Family Welfare, Tamralipta, West Bengal, has invited applications for 12 posts in 3 roles under Advt No. CMOH/PbMd/AYUSH/6829. The posts include Multi Purpose Worker (MPW), Yoga Instructor - Male, Yoga Instructor - Female. The online application is open from 7 November 2026 to 4 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online mode only. Last date to pay the fee: 3 December 2026.

age_limit.age_details: Varies by post - see the table below

qualification.education_qualification: MPW: Graduate from any recognized university plus at least 1 year diploma course in computer (including MS Office) from a Govt. registered institution. Yoga Instructor: Secondary/Madhyamik passed with certificate/Diploma/Degree in yoga affiliated by WBCYN and registration with WBCYN.

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Graduate from any recognized university; At least 1 year diploma course in computer (Including MS office - MS Word, MS Power Point, MS Excel.) from Govt. registered Institution. Experience required: Desirable: Exposure in social sector schemes / Govt. Missions at National, State and District level. Age limit: Minimum 21 years to maximum 40 years. Pay: Rs. 15,000 Per Month (Consolidated). Qualification required: Secondary/Madhyamik passed with certificate/Diploma/Degree in yoga affiliated by the West Bengal Council of Yoga and Naturopathy (WBCYN); Must be registered with WBCYN; Permanent resident of West Bengal. Age limit: Minimum 18 years to maximum 40 years. Pay: Male: 8000/Month [Rs. 250/session, Maximum32 session/Month]. Qualification required: Secondary/Madhyami

salary_details.pay_scale: MPW Rs. 15,000 per month (consolidated); Yoga Instructor Male Rs. 8,000 per month and Female Rs. 5,000 per month at Rs. 250 per session

exam_pattern.details: Marks are calculated excluding marks of Additional Subject Proportionate marking up to 2 decimal points will be considered

how_to_apply: Apply online as given in www.wbhealth.gov.in/online recruitment from 11 am of 07.11.2026.
Complete registration and fee payment by 3 December 2026.
Pay the fee (Rs. 100 general, Rs. 50 reserved) through online mode only.
Upload proper signature and photograph with the online application.
Complete full submission of the application form by midnight of 4 December 2026.
Download the registration form print from http://hr.wbhealth.gov.in/Index.aspx -> Application Print and keep it for document verification.
important_instructions: No need to send hard copy of the online registration form by post Retain the online registration number; employer will not give information on it later Online details differing from original testimonials make the application liable to cancellation No document can be added during verification except those marked applied for in the application Corrigendum, interview date, venue and shortlisting will be published on www.wbhealth.gov.in and www.purbamedinipur.gov.in

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Chief Medical Officer of Health, Purba Medinipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 4 December 2026. Applications opened on 7 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Chief Medical Officer of Health, Purba Medinipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 12 vacancies: 1 Multi Purpose Worker (MPW), 5 Yoga Instructor - Male, 6 Yoga Instructor - Female.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Chief Medical Officer of Health, Purba Medinipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General: Rs. 100. Reserved category: Rs. 50.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Multi Purpose Worker (MPW): minimum 21 years to maximum 40 years; Yoga Instructor - Male: minimum 18 years to maximum 40 years; Yoga Instructor - Female: minimum 18 years to maximum 40 years. Relaxation: As per Govt. norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 15,000 Per Month (Consolidated) for Multi Purpose Worker (MPW), Male: 8000/Month [Rs. 250/session, Maximum32 session/Month] for Yoga Instructor - Male, Female: 5000/Month [Rs. 250/session, Maximum20 session/Month] for Yoga Instructor - Female.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MPW: Graduate from any recognized university plus at least 1 year diploma course in computer (including MS Office) from a Govt. registered institution. Yoga Instructor: Secondary/Madhyamik passed with certificate/Diploma/Degree in yoga affiliated by WBCYN and registration with WBCYN. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicant must be a permanent resident of West Bengal. Applicant must have knowledge of local languages. Yoga Instructors must be registered with WBCYN. All essential qualifications must be completed on or before the first date of online application.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Experience gained while pursuing the course is not counted. Duplicate applications will be summarily rejected. Candidates who skip any stage of recruitment will be disqualified.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MPW: Academic Score, Computer Test and Experience. Yoga Instructor (Male/Female): Academic Score, Demonstration and Interview. MPW: Basic qualification 75 marks, proportionate on % of marks in final degree examination. MPW: Computer Test 15 marks, minimum passing marks 50%.
